name: Salad bowl
summary: Wooden bowl heaped with green leaves, red tomatoes and yellow accents; for healthy food and kitchen scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the bowl rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the bowl is hero size (~440 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: vesselColor
params.note: bowl colour (wood by default; use a green or white for a ceramic bowl)

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
